topic: Physio, chiro, Pilates and massage under one roof: how we refer

slides.headline: Physio, chiro, Pilates or massage?
slides.sub: How we decide who's right for you, and when we refer.

slides.title: Start with whoever suits you
slides.body: There's no wrong door. Book with a physio, chiropractor, our Pilates team or a remedial massage therapist, and they'll assess you and let you know if someone else may help.

slides.title: How the roles differ
slides.body: Physios and chiropractors assess and treat pain and injuries. Clinical Pilates builds strength and control through guided exercise. Remedial massage eases tight muscles and helps you feel more comfortable.

slides.title: When we refer in-house
slides.body: If progress stalls, your goals change, or another approach suits you better, we'll suggest it and explain why. You're always free to choose, and there's no pressure to add sessions.

slides.title: Shared notes, one plan
slides.body: With your consent, our practitioners share notes so you don't have to repeat your story. Your plan stays consistent, whether you see one person or combine a couple of services.

slides.title: And when we refer out
slides.body: Sometimes you need your GP, imaging or a specialist opinion. We'll tell you clearly when that's the case and write to your GP so everyone is on the same page.

slides.headline: Not sure where to start?
slides.body: Book with any of our practitioners or call the clinic, and we'll point you in the right direction. Book online — link in bio.

caption:
Physio, chiro, Pilates or massage? You don't have to work it out alone.

At Hybrid Physiotherapy, there's no wrong door. Whoever you book with will assess you, and if another practitioner may suit you better, they'll explain why. Physios and chiropractors assess and treat pain and injuries, clinical Pilates builds strength and control, and remedial massage eases tight muscles.

With your consent, we share notes so you don't have to repeat your story, and your plan stays consistent across services. There's never pressure to add sessions. When you need your GP, imaging or a specialist, we'll say so clearly and keep your GP in the loop.

Not sure where to start? Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
